description: Optimized force field parameters for concentrated electrolyte MD simulations
methodology: OPLS-AA/SPC-E hybrid with scaled-charge ion model
rationale: ECC (Electronic Continuum Correction) accounts for electronic polarization implicitly

Li+.source: Kann & Skinner, J. Chem. Phys. 2014; Leontyev & Stuchebrukhov, PCCP 2011

PF6-.source: Lopes & Padua, J. Phys. Chem. B 2004, with ECC correction

Na+.source: Reference for comparison: Benavides et al., J. Chem. Phys. 2017

Cl-.source: Reference for comparison: Benavides et al., J. Chem. Phys. 2017

EC.source: Jorgensen et al., JACS 1996; refined by Nikitin & Del Popolo 2015

DMC.source: Jorgensen et al., JACS 1996; refined for carbonate solvents

optimization_targets: solvation free energy of Li+ (±5 kJ/mol)
